hero.description: {{siteName}} delivers exceptional construction and renovation services across {{serviceArea}}. Quality craftsmanship. On time. On budget.

about.paragraph1: Founded in {{year}} by master craftsman Robert Vance, {{siteName}} has grown from a two-man operation into one of Denver's most trusted construction teams – all without losing the personal touch that made us.
about.paragraph2: We believe your home deserves the same care we'd give our own. That means skilled tradespeople, premium materials, transparent communication, and zero shortcuts. Every single time.

trustSignals.licensedDesc: Fully licensed in Colorado and comprehensively insured so you're protected on every project.
trustSignals.onTimeDesc: We set realistic timelines and stick to them. Your schedule is as important to us as it is to you.
trustSignals.qualityDesc: Every project backed by our craftsmanship warranty. We don't consider a job done until you're thrilled.
trustSignals.ratedDesc: 98% client satisfaction over 500+ completed projects. Our reputation is our greatest asset.

servicesSection.headline: Our Services
servicesSection.description: From a single room refresh to a complete home transformation, we have the expertise and crew to deliver outstanding results.

homeRenovation.title: Home Renovation
homeRenovation.description: Full-scale home transformations – from structural changes to finishing touches. We bring your vision to life on time and on budget.

kitchenRenovation.title: Kitchen Renovation
kitchenRenovation.description: Custom cabinetry, countertops, island builds, and appliance integration. Kitchens that are as functional as they are beautiful.

bathroomRenovation.title: Bathroom Renovation
bathroomRenovation.description: Spa-quality remodels featuring walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and premium tile work that stand the test of time.

interiorConstruction.title: Interior Construction
interiorConstruction.description: Framing, drywall, ceilings, custom built-ins, and open-plan conversions. The backbone behind every great interior.

painting.title: Interior & Exterior Painting
painting.description: Flawless prep, premium paints, and expert application for a finish that lasts. Residential and light commercial.

roofing.title: Roofing
roofing.description: Roof installation, repair, and replacement using top-grade materials. We protect what matters most – your home.
